occupation_titles: Underground drainage, Floor, Bath Room & Toilet, and other workers engaged in similar kinds of work including such works being carried on with the help of Machines.
records.zone_description: Notified areas of Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP)
records.exclusions: Excludes cleaning/scavenging works in Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) and Panchayath Raj Institutions; applies only to private Safai Karmacharis in private establishments.
records.legal_authority: Government of Karnataka, Department of Labour
records.verified_by: Namma Sambala Legal & Wage Research Working Group
records.verification_notes: Verified rate for Zone 1 (BBMP). Notification No. KAE 105 LWA 2021 dated 28.07.2022 (Gazette 06-08-2022). Effective from 28.07.2022. VDA rate calculated at 4 paise/point over 7,616 points (CPI 10,328 - 7,616 = 2,712 points = Rs. 125.17/day, Rs. 3,254.40/month) valid from 01-04-2026 to 31-03-2027. Excludes Safai Karmacharis employed directly in Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) and Panchayaths.
